results.description:
Coming from nothing, Alek Koslov fought and clawed his way to the top. Creating and founding "The Sinners MC" all on his own, he becomes the head of the ruthless biker gang.

Alek will do anything but go back to the life he used to live, even if that means tearing down everything and everyone in his way.

Daisy Cooper is a tough and gentle soul who used to teach before the Koslovs tore down her school, and now she's forced to work for none other than the devil himself.

They’re like two raging storms, clashing at every turn, yet there’s something between them that can’t be denied. Passion. Heat. Unstoppable desire. It’s a dangerous game of love and power, where every moment risks burning them both alive… or igniting a fire neither of them can put out.

This book is part of the Koslov Brothers series, each book can be read in any order. The books in the series are Alek, Leo, Ares.
